description: This file defines a static helper class for generating and managing dynamic permissions related to content types within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes permission templates, methods for creating permissions based on content type definitions, and permission conversion logic.

classes.name: ContentTypePermissionsHelper
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate and manage dynamic permissions for content types.

methods.name: ConvertToDynamicPermission
methods.description: Returns a dynamic permission for a content type based on a global permission template.

methods.name: CreateDynamicPermission
methods.description: Generates a permission dynamically for a content type, either from a definition or a string identifier.
